name: Esterification
description: The reaction of organic carboxylic acids with alcohols in the presence of an acid catalyst to produce sweet-smelling esters.
mechanism: Protonation of the carbonyl oxygen by the acid catalyst.
Nucleophilic attack of the alcohol oxygen on the protonated carbonyl carbon.
Proton transfer from the alcohol group to one of the OH groups.
Elimination of water (leaving group) to form protonated ester.
Deprotonation of the ester by solvent to reform acid catalyst.
